# JEE syllabus by chapter

From the Syllabus for JEE (Main) 2027, Paper 1 (B.E./B.Tech.) (National Testing Agency, published 2026-10-24) and the JEE (Advanced) 2026 Information Brochure, Annexure I: Syllabi. Topics are shortened from the official wording.

| Subject | Chapters | Main and Advanced | Main only | Advanced only |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Physics | 27 | 25 | 2 | 0 |
| Chemistry | 31 | 22 | 0 | 9 |
| Mathematics | 20 | 20 | 0 | 0 |
